Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Exact PvP cues, Smart Tab, reliable held helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with exact native-nameplate cues, LB notifications, pressure and CC awareness, PvP range rings, a Wolves' Den CC rotation panel, a bounded Purify-first held scheduler, Smart Tab, Emergency Teleport, assist macros, local MP sounds, job tools, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds /seitonenavant for DNC: one explicit En Avant follows the character's fresh world movement direction, including strafe and diagonals, without camera or target changes. It reuses the existing default-off directional-dash option and exact one-call En Avant boundary; stationary, stale, discontinuous, or identity-changing movement fails closed with no queue, retry, or fallback. Schema 48; live cardinal and diagonal validation remains pending.
